ayahOccurrences.text: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: رَانَ is in the derivative form: رَانَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ر/ي/ن   r–y–n filth, rust; to cover, to engulf, to seal, to overwhelm, to overpower, to prevail. Of this root, رَانَ rāna occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
رَانَ rāna ı [v. intrans.] to encrust, to rust, to engulf, to corrode, to stifle

(83:14) كَلاَّ بَلْ رَانَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ no indeed!, but what they have committed has corroded their hearts.
